```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(pvclust)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(performance)
library(broom.mixed)
library(multcomp)
library(multcompView)
library(ggrepel)

custom_shapes <- c(23, 22, 15, 16, 17, 18, 21, 24)
species_colors <- c(
  "AABR" = "#046E8F", 
  "AGLO" = "lightgreen", 
  "AHYA" = "#D44D5C",
  "ICRA" = "#462255"  
)

pp_90_multiverse <- readRDS(here("Outputs", "ed_90_multiverse.rds"))

#load data
df_modeling_new <- pp_90_multiverse %>%
 # 1. Standardize column names (Species -> species, site = timepoint)
  rename_with(~ "species", matches("^Species$")) %>%
  rename_with(~ "site", matches("^Site$")) %>%
  mutate(
    site    = as.factor(site),
    species = as.factor(species),
    across(starts_with("K_"), as.factor)
  ) %>%
  #2. Filter out missing modeling variables
  filter(!is.na(ED50), !is.na(site), !is.na(species))

# =========================================================================
# STEP 2: Baseline Species Model
# =========================================================================
spp_m <- lmer(ED50 ~ species + (1 | site), data = df_modeling_new, REML = TRUE)

# =========================================================================
# STEP 3: Run Mixed Models Across All New K Clusters (pp_90 Data)
# =========================================================================
k_cols <- colnames(df_modeling_new)[str_detect(colnames(df_modeling_new), "^K_")]
all_models <- list("Just_Spp" = spp_m)

for (k_col in k_cols) {
  k_num <- str_extract(k_col, "\\d+")
  
  # Model 1: Cluster alone + (1|site)
  f_m  <- as.formula(paste0("ED50 ~ ", k_col, " + (1 | site)"))
  all_models[[paste0("k", k_num, "m")]] <- lmer(f_m, data = df_modeling_new, REML = TRUE)
  
  # Model 2: Species + Cluster + (1|site)
  f_ms <- as.formula(paste0("ED50 ~ species + ", k_col, " + (1 | site)"))
  all_models[[paste0("k", k_num, "ms")]] <- lmer(f_ms, data = df_modeling_new, REML = TRUE)
  
  # Model 3: Species * Cluster interaction + (1|site)
  f_msi <- as.formula(paste0("ED50 ~ species * ", k_col, " + (1 | site)"))
  all_models[[paste0("k", k_num, "msi")]] <- tryCatch(
    lmer(f_msi, data = df_modeling_new, REML = TRUE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}

all_models <- compact(all_models)

# =========================================================================
# STEP 4: Master Performance Table (AIC, BIC, Marginal & Conditional R2)
# =========================================================================
master_model_table <- imap_dfr(all_models, function(model_obj, model_name) {
  perf <- model_performance(model_obj)
  r2_vals <- r2(model_obj)
  
  data.frame(
    Model_Name      = model_name,
    AIC             = round(perf$AIC, 1),
    BIC             = round(perf$BIC, 1),
    Marginal_R2     = round(r2_vals$R2_marginal, 3),
    Conditional_R2  = round(r2_vals$R2_conditional, 3),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}) %>%
  arrange(BIC)

cat("\n--- TOP MODELS RANKED BY BIC (BASED ON NEW pp_90 CLUSTERS) ---\n")
print(head(master_model_table, 15))

# =========================================================================
# STEP 5: Model Efficiency Frontier Plot
# =========================================================================
plot_data <- master_model_table %>%
  rename(R2_target = Conditional_R2)

frontier_data <- plot_data %>%
  arrange(BIC, desc(R2_target)) %>%
  mutate(cum_max_R2 = cummax(R2_target)) %>%
  filter(R2_target == cum_max_R2) %>%
  distinct(R2_target, .keep_all = TRUE)

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(is_frontier = Model_Name %in% frontier_data$Model_Name)

p_frontier <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = BIC, y = R2_target)) +
  geom_point(data = filter(plot_data, !is_frontier), color = "gray60", size = 2.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(data = filter(plot_data, is_frontier), color = "#1f77b4", size = 4) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Model_Name, color = is_frontier),
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = ifelse(plot_data$is_frontier, "bold", "plain"),
    max.overlaps = 20,
    box.padding = 0.35
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#1f77b4", "FALSE" = "gray30")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Model Efficiency Frontier (pp_90 Filtered Clusters)",
    subtitle = "BIC vs Conditional R² for clusters built on r < 0.90 trait matrix",
    x = "BIC",
    y = expression("Conditional " * R^2)
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

print(p_frontier)
```


```{r}
# =========================================================================
# STEP 6: Plot Best Model EMMs & Raw Data Points
# =========================================================================
selected_model_name <- "k3ms" 
best_model          <- all_models[[selected_model_name]]
print(anova(best_model))
performance(best_model)
# --- 2. Extract EMMs &  Letter Display ---
k3ms_cluster_emm <- emmeans(best_model, specs = ~ K_3) 
pairs(k3ms_cluster_emm, adjust="tukey")
# BEST MODEL k3ms 
# --- 1. Model Checks & ANOVA ---
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(resid(best_model) ~ fitted(best_model), main = "Residuals vs Fitted (k3ms)", xlab = "Fitted", ylab = "Residuals")
qqnorm(resid(best_model), main = "Normal Q-Q Plot (k3ms)")
qqline(resid(best_model), col = "red")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1)) 


# --- 2. Extract EMMs & Letter Display ---
# weights = "proportional" calculates marginal means based on observed species counts in each cluster
k3ms_cluster_emm <- emmeans(best_model, specs = ~ K_3, weights = "proportional") 

# Convert EMM to dataframe and compute CLD letters
cld_clusters <- cld(k3ms_cluster_emm, adjust = "tukey", Letters = letters) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    K_3 = as.factor(K_3),
    .group = trimws(.group)
  )

# Verify clean numbers
print(cld_clusters)

# --- 3. Generate Efficiency/Performance Plot with Raw Data ---
plot_k3ms <- ggplot() +
  # Layer A: Raw data jittered points (colored by species, shape by site)
  geom_jitter(
    data = df_modeling_new, 
    aes(x = as.factor(K_3), y = ED50, color = species, shape = site),
    width = 0.18, 
    alpha = 0.55, 
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  # Layer B: Model Estimated Marginal Means (Black points + Error bars)
  geom_errorbar(
    data = cld_clusters,
    aes(x = K_3, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
    width = 0.12, 
    linewidth = 0.9, 
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = cld_clusters,
    aes(x = K_3, y = emmean),
    size = 4, 
    color = "black"
  ) +
  # Layer C: Statistical significance letters (CLD)
  geom_text(
    data = cld_clusters,
    aes(x = K_3, y = upper.CL + 0.15, label = .group),
    fontface = "bold", 
    size = 5.5, 
    color = "black"
  ) +
  # Styling & Labels
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Photophysiological Cluster (K = 3)",
    y = expression(Estimated~Marginal~Mean~ED50~"("*degree*C*")"),
    color = "Species",
    shape = "Site"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = custom_shapes) +
  scale_color_manual(values = species_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = species_colors) 

print(plot_k3ms)
```
